facts.title: takeout-style sesame noodles with cucumber
ingredients: 3/4 pound dried rice noodles (see notes up top)
2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil, plus a splash to loosen noodles
2 tablespoons Chinese sesame paste or tahini (see note up top)
1/2 cup roasted salted peanuts, roughly chopped
A handful of chopped fresh herbs, such as mint and cilantro, for garnish
facts.yield_text: Serves 4, generously, and up to double that if served as shown, with lots of cucumber, peanuts and herbs
facts.author: Deb Perelman
